description.value: Riders Liquor Store is a locally owned and operated retail liquor store in the Langley-Brookswood community, recently refreshed under new ownership with a broadly expanded selection spanning wine, whiskey, gin, tequila, rum, liqueurs, and more — including a fully chilled white-wine section and a dedicated boxed-wine area. The store price-matches local competitors and government store prices, and offers seniors discounts and bulk-purchase discounts for events. Open every day of the year, it makes a straightforward resupply stop for touring cyclists moving through the Langley corridor.
